transport.title: Buses to the city
transport.text: SkyBus Melbourne City Express connects the airport with Southern Cross station daily from 04:00 to 01:00, with stops at Terminals 1, 3 and 4. Tickets are sold online and at machines by the stops; cash purchases are available at Prosegur and Smart Carte in Terminal 2 arrivals. PTV public buses depart from the Terminal 4 ground transport hub.

storage.title: Baggage storage
storage.text: Self-service lockers are on the ground level of the Terminal 4 car park, beneath the escalators. Smartecarte on the ground level of Terminal 2 arrivals is open daily from 06:00 to midnight and also offers printing and faxing.

sleep.title: Hotels near the terminals
sleep.text: PARKROYAL Melbourne Airport is connected to the domestic and international terminals by elevated pedestrian walkways. Holiday Inn Melbourne Airport is 400 m from the terminals and provides its guests with a free bus to and from the terminal on request.

kids.title: Parents’ rooms
kids.text: Nappy-changing facilities are available in all terminals. In Terminal 2, they are on Level 1 before security near check-in areas M and F, and on Level 1 after security beyond Duty Free and opposite gates 3 and 16. The room on the ground level of Terminal 2 arrivals is opposite Smartcarte baggage storage.

wifi.title: Free Wi-Fi
wifi.text: The free Airport Free Wi-Fi network is available in Terminals 2, 3 and 4, including public areas and waiting lounges. This network is not available in Terminal 1, which is operated by Qantas. The free connection is not encrypted.
